verdict.rationale: Box's developer reference (developer.box.com/reference) documents the API with runnable curl examples and access-token instructions, indicating a live reference with executable requests, but the pack lacks confirmation of an in-browser 'try it' console or an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (the probe found all OpenAPI URLs 404), so true interactivity is unproven. missing for 10: confirmed in-browser runnable console, discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on verification of interactivity.
